topic: Aivazidis–Loukaki–Müller, arXiv:2209.00986v2, Problem 5.2, p. 37: normal extensions, equality and related questions
title: Normal-extension monotonicity: Problem 5.2 of Aivazidis, Loukaki and Müller (arXiv:2209.00986v2, p. 37)

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We answer yes to Problem 5.2 of Aivazidis, Loukaki and Müller (arXiv:2209.00986v2, p. 37; journal version, p. 1280): for every finite group G, H ≤ G and N normal in G, P_G(H) ≤ P_G(HN). Equality holds exactly when N ≤ H or H is normal in G. The same criterion with N = ker f characterizes equality in the homomorphism inequality (5.1). The note also proves the coprime-order assertion in Problem 5.3 and supplies a finite-quotient probability model for the finite-index setting in Problem 5.4.
summary: A complete double-coset proof with structural equality, homomorphism consequences, coprime direct products, finite-index quotients and exact finite checks.
